name: Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Elite Mastercard®

localized_names.en: Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Elite Mastercard®

apr.notes: The variable APR for purchases and balance transfers is 19.49% – 29.49%, based on your creditworthiness. The variable APR for cash advances is 29.74%. The variable Penalty APR is up to 29.99%. Minimum interest charge – $0.50. Cash advance fee – either $10 or 5% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Balance transfer fee – either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater. The annual fee for Authorized Users is $175 for up to 3 Authorized Users and $175 for each Authorized User thereafter.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 AAdvantage® mile for every $1 spent on all other purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Earn 1 Loyalty Point for every 1 eligible AAdvantage® mile earned from purchases to reach AAdvantage® status faster.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 70,000 American Airlines AAdvantage® bonus miles and enjoy the only credit card with Admirals Club® membership. Bonus miles earned after $7,000 in purchases within the first 3 months of account opening.

benefits.title: Complimentary Admirals Club® membership
benefits.description: Primary cardmembers can enjoy access to Admirals Club® lounges worldwide – a value of up to $850. Enjoy complimentary drinks and snacks, stay connected with free Wi-Fi, get access to conference rooms and much more.

benefits.title: Up to 20,000 additional Loyalty Points
benefits.description: Earn a 10,000 Loyalty Point bonus after reaching 50,000 Loyalty Points in a status qualification year. Earn another 10,000 Loyalty Point bonus after reaching 90,000 Loyalty Points in the same status qualification year.

benefits.title: Global Entry® or TSA PreCheck® application fee credit
benefits.description: You're eligible to receive a statement credit (up to $120 every 4 years) as reimbursement for your Global Entry® or TSA PreCheck® application fee.

benefits.title: Enhanced airport experience
benefits.description: Enjoy an enhanced airport experience including priority check-in, screening, and boarding when flying with American Airlines.

benefits.title: First checked bag free
benefits.description: Your first checked bag is free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to eight companions traveling with you on the same reservation, a savings of up to $900 per round trip.

benefits.title: Save 25% on inflight food and beverage purchases
benefits.description: 25% savings on inflight food and beverage purchases on American Airlines flights when you use your credit card.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Shop like a local wherever you go with your Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive® credit card.

benefits.title: Travel protection benefits
benefits.description: Help protect your next trip with Trip Cancellation & Interruption Protection, Trip Delay Protection, Lost Baggage Protection and Worldwide Car Rental Insurance Coverage.

benefits.title: Up to $120 back on Eligible Prepaid Avis® and Budget Car Rentals
benefits.description: Earn up to $120 in statement credits every calendar year when eligible prepaid car rentals are booked directly on avis.com or budget.com.

benefits.title: Up to $120 Lyft credit
benefits.description: After taking 3 eligible rides in a calendar month, you will earn a $10 Lyft credit, for a total of up to $120 back in Lyft credits annually.

benefits.title: Up to $120 back on eligible Grubhub purchases
benefits.description: Earn a statement credit of up to $10 per monthly billing statement on eligible Grubhub purchases, for a total of up to $120 every 12 billing statements.

lounge_access.notes: Complimentary Admirals Club® membership – access to Admirals Club® lounges worldwide (value up to $850)
